data_objects.name: site_differential_selection
data_objects.meaning: Site-level summaries of differential-selection scores, separated into absolute, positive, negative, largest, and smallest components.
data_objects.notes: The biological entity, comparison, score construction, and scale are not stated in train.csv.

variables.name: site
variables.meaning: Identifier of the measured site; identifiers can be numeric-like or carry a parenthesized prefix.

variables.name: abs_diffsel
variables.meaning: Aggregate absolute differential-selection score for the site.

variables.name: positive_diffsel
variables.meaning: Aggregate positive differential-selection component for the site.

variables.name: negative_diffsel
variables.meaning: Aggregate negative differential-selection component for the site.

variables.name: max_diffsel
variables.meaning: Largest differential-selection component recorded for the site.

variables.name: min_diffsel
variables.meaning: Smallest differential-selection component recorded for the site.

structure.description: Each row represents one site identifier with a set of differential-selection summaries; site serves as the row key.
The score columns preserve sign-specific and extremal summaries for the same site.

uncertainties: The meaning of prefixed site identifiers and whether they denote separate sequences or namespaces is unspecified.
The exact aggregation definitions, comparison direction, score units, and interpretation are not established by train.csv.
annotation_notes: Differential-selection meanings follow the source labels while leaving the undocumented scientific context unresolved.
